providers.name: mistral
providers.//v0937: v0.93.7: THE SPACE-SIDE MISTRAL GAP — the engine wired mistral dynamic in v0.91.7 (fetchOpenAICompatible field-union + effectiveBaseURL) but the BRAIN's registry (what the Spaces resolve /chat against) never got the entry, so every mistral/<model> turn on a Space died 400 'could not resolve model'. Zero static model lists (the user's v0.91.7 rule): models sync live from models_url with the request's key; mistral-medium-3-5 is the flagship (reasoning_effort none|high per the live registry).

providers.name: cloudflare
providers.note: fast. CF DEFAULTS max_tokens=256 - always pass it explicitly (we do). newer slots (kimi 262k / nemotron-120b 256k / gemma-4 256k ctx) expose reasoning_effort + chat_template_kwargs (see reasoning_catalog); legacy slots (llama-3.3 24k / qwen-coder 32k ctx) have no reasoning params. r1-distill REMOVED 2026-06: captest showed it confidently proposing a deadlock-inducing fix.

providers.note: OpenCode Zen — curated model gateway. Free models (deepseek-v4-flash-free, big-pickle, nemotron-3-ultra-free, mimo-v2.5-free, north-mini-code-free) have 0$ inference. Paid models billed per-token via Zen account. API key: opencode.ai/auth. Auto-syncs new models from /v1/models at boot.

providers.name: opencode-go
providers.note: OpenCode Go ($10/mo subscription, $5 first month). Includes GLM-5.2, Kimi K2.6/K2.7, DeepSeek V4 Pro/Flash, MiMo-V2.5, MiniMax M3/M2.7, Qwen3.7/3.6 Plus. Hosted in US, EU, SG. Auto-syncs new models from /v1/models at boot.

providers.name: privatemodeai
providers.note: v0.91.8 THE SIDECAR: chat rides brain/pmproxy.mjs (the Node OpenAI-compatible shim doing the E2E-encrypted calls through the vendored SDK — pm_sidecar.py spawns it lazily on first PM use; litellm cannot speak the protocol). Model LISTING stays on the real API (the /v1/models listing is not encrypted). Port via DOOMALAY_PM_PROXY_PORT (default 8530).

providers.name: hf
providers.//v110: v1.10.6 THE HF ROUTER: Hugging Face's own inference router serves 130+ models with the SAME token the user already connected (HF_TOKEN) — no separate provider key. Live-proven 2026-10-06 (GLM-5.3-Flash answered). This is the always-available fallback when every BYOK provider is dead, and the engine already ships HF tokens to own spaces (turnRemoteEnv).
